Go's omitempty drops git.auto_push/auto_pull false and the loader default is true, so an opt-out turns into an opt-in; Rust writes the false
Go's omitempty drops clipboard.copyByDefault false and the loader default is true; Rust writes the false
Go's omitempty drops a zero port/timeout/rate limit and a false metrics_auth_required, and the loader defaults (8080, 10s, 60, true) replace them; Rust writes the operator's value
Go holds *bool: an explicit false on a custom profile is a set pointer and is written back; Rust holds bool and omits it, which reloads to the same false (a missing capability is false)
